Human Culture

Humans are everywhere, so it's no surprise that more Fenari settle among them than any other people. Human cities are full of the things Fenari love most: markets, gossip, crowds to perform for, and more unattended valuables than anyone could possibly keep track of.

Human Fenari change the least in body, as there's little for them to borrow, but the most in outlook. They pick up their hosts' restless ambition and knack for learning anything at all, and tend to throw themselves into trades, guilds, and grand plans with the same vigor other Fenari save for treasure hunting.

They're as varied as the Humans they live among: honest merchants and notorious fences, temple acolytes and street performers, often several of these in a single week.

Alignment. Fenari who live among Humans vary as widely in alignment as the Humans they grew up with.

Fenari Traits

  • Size. Fenari grow between 4'0" and 5'2" tall and weigh 70 to 120 pounds. Your size is Small or Medium (choose when you select this species).
  • Creature Type. Humanoid
  • Speed. 30 feet
  • Darkvision. You can see in Dim Light within 60 feet of you as if it were Bright Light, and in Darkness as if it were Dim Light.
  • Enhanced Senses. You have proficiency in the Perception skill.
  • Bite. Your fanged maw is a natural weapon you can use to make Unarmed Strikes, dealing 1d6 + your Strength modifier Piercing damage on a hit.
  • Languages. Common and one other language of your choice.
  • Versatility. You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice and an Origin feat of your choice.

See the The Fenari journal for the Fenari's history, Creed, and appearance.
